assist_prefix: Home assistant. Rooms that exist: hall, kitchen, bedroom, living_room, front_door. Rules: only explicit commands act; negated, ambiguous, indirect or unknown-room commands give action hold; any unlock gives action hold. Command:

budget.gate: MemAvailable > 800 MB and swap < 25% before each phase and every 10 calls (4 tries, 30 s apart, then abort phase)
budget.shrink_rule: after T0 (50 calls): L = mean call s; rem = 900 - T0 model s. If 50*4*L <= rem: k_extra=4 (k=5). Elif 50*2*L <= rem: k_extra=2 (k=3). Else k_extra=2 on the first floor(rem/(2L)) items in frozen order. Hard stop at 1.10*900 s model time. H3 uses only items with all k samples.

framings:
{spec}
Reply with only one line of JSON: {schema} /no_think

You are a precise engineering assistant. Task: {spec}
Output exactly one JSON object like {schema} and nothing else. /no_think

H1.claim: raw model accuracy is well below 100%
H1.metric: raw_correct rate over all 50 items at T0 (F0)

H2.claim: with the deterministic gate, silent wrong answers passed = 0
H2.known_limit: for numeric items recompute and key share keys.py, so H2 mainly tests that the gate is wired correctly and runs identically on two seats; the non-trivial part is jp_en (dictionary oracle) and assist (independent parser vs human key)
H2.metric: count silent_wrong over ALL outputs (T0 + consensus framings), each verifier seat
H2.secondary_prediction_S2: schema-only gate passes >= 1 silent wrong answer (shows the recompute step is what matters)

H3.claim: agreement among k samples is not a reliable proxy for correctness
H3.metric: 2x2 of unanimous(k framings) vs raw_correct(F0) over items with all k samples; precision=P(correct|unanimous), recall=P(unanimous|correct); count unanimous-wrong

H4.claim: verifier runs on the other node with byte-identical verdicts
H4.metric: sha256(VERDICTS.json) on JUPI == on JUPI 2; key_check.recomputed_equals_frozen true on both

rules: no installs; no GPU; no service changes; requests only to the on-node local model server

sampling.consensus_samples: temperature 0.7 with seeds is NOT exposed by groku-muse v1 (server forces temp 0 seed 1) and the only sampler-capable endpoint is the GPU server, which is off-limits. Substitute frozen here: k samples = k deterministic prompt framings F0..F(k-1) of the same item (paraphrase self-consistency). Stated as a deviation from the brief.

seats.orchestration: orchestration host via the lab peer; analysis on the orchestration host
seats.translator: JUPI 2 (groku-muse, qwen3-0.6b, on-node local model server, requests only)
seats.verifier_primary: JUPI -- no model server; verifies JUPI 2 outputs
seats.verifier_secondary: JUPI 2 -- verifies the same outputs and re-derives the answer key; JUPI re-derives it too

thesis_under_test: Argon/Kam: LLMs as semantic compilers upstream of deterministic verifiers; MODEL_CONSENSUS != GOVERNING_AUTHORITY; assistive AI needs zero silent corruption.

translator.abort_rule: stop all calls if any response reports backend other than cpu
translator.server_facts_read_only: groku-muse-server-v1.py hard-codes --temp 0 --seed 1, caps max_tokens at 64, -c 512; gpu-disabled flag present -> CPU llama-cli path. Direct llama-server on the local GPU port is the Vulkan path and is NOT used (GPU stays off per standing rules).

baselines.consensus_gate: PASS iff all k framings give the same normalized answer
baselines.schema_only_gate: PASS iff parsed AND schema_ok (typical JSON-mode pipeline)

verifier.extraction: strip <think>...</think>; first balanced {...} that json-parses to an object (fallback: search the unstripped text)
verifier.gate: PASS iff parsed AND schema_ok AND recompute agrees; else HOLD (system emits hold / no answer)
verifier.norm_answer: num -> %.6g; bool -> str; str -> norm; act -> json tuple; unparsed -> None (breaks unanimity)
verifier.raw_correct: lenient read with no schema demands: JSON answer if present (strings coerced), else first number / true|false|yes|no / hex run / accept-term substring in text
verifier.recompute: num/int/bool/hex/str: verifier re-evaluates recompute_expr with stdlib (keys.py) and compares; act: verifier runs an independent rule-based intent parser (keys.parse_intent) on the command text and requires agreement (hold-vs-hold needs only action=hold)
verifier.schema: num/int: answer is finite int|float, not bool; bool: answer is bool; str/hex: non-empty string; act: keys subset of {action,device,room,level}, action in {turn_on,turn_off,set_level,hold}, device in {light,tv,thermostat,lock,null}, room in {hall,kitchen,bedroom,living_room,front_door,null}, level int|null
verifier.string_norm: strip, strip trailing .!?。, lowercase; str correct iff in accept list; hex exact
verifier.truly_correct: schema-valid answer equal to the FROZEN key in this file (human-written for jp_en and assist)
